Alex Cheng: Quick check — onboarding Santorini-7b v1. I pushed weights to s3://redwood-models/catalog/santorini-7b/v1/weights/ (sharded x4). Did a smoke perf sweep and tokenizer token counts looked inflated on emoji-heavy prompts. Anyone seen emoji/tokenizer weirdness for this family?

Maria García: Noted the weights path. Which tokenizer are you using (HF fast/slow/BPE)? Also, what were the exact perf sweep params?

Alex Cheng: HF tokenizer from repo path referenced in manifest: models/santorini/tokenizer/vocab.json + tokenizer_config.json. Sweep: batch_sizes = [1,2,4,8,16], seq_len=1024, continuous_batching=true, max_batch_size=8. Observed p95 latency spike at batch=8 and throughput plateaus at batch=4. Paste from runtime logs: 

```
[bench] batch=4 throughput=68.2 req/s p50=420ms p95=480ms
[bench] batch=8 throughput=71.0 req/s p50=760ms p95=820ms
[warn] tokenizer: token_count mismatch for input id 0 -> 27 vs 18 expected
```

Sam K: Two quick suspects: (1) tokenizer config vs model special tokens mismatch (bos/eos ids) and (2) using the fast tokenizer with byte-level BPE can split emoji. Check tokenizer_config.json for `add_prefix_space` / `use_fast` flags. Example command to inspect: `jq .tokenizer_config tokenizer_config.json`

Li Yuan: Also watch for sequence length handling. If model config max_position_embeddings=2048 but runtime truncates differently, we sometimes hit slower attention paths (reshape/fallback) that blow up p95. For Santorini the model metadata shows max_position_embeddings: 2048 — try a run at seq_len=2048 to compare kernel paths.

Jenna Patel: I ran a short sweep on dedicated infra (p4d) with q8 quant and prefix cache enabled. Numbers pasted here:
batch=1 -> p50 180ms p95 260ms throughput 22.0 req/s
batch=4 -> p50 420ms p95 480ms throughput 68.2 req/s
batch=8 -> p50 760ms p95 820ms throughput 71.0 req/s
Conclusion: batching beyond 4 gives tiny throughput gains but much worse p95. For production SLAs prefer batch <=4 or enable strict latency SLO path.

Maria García: For tokenizer fixes: set `use_fast=false` and `add_prefix_space=true` and explicitly set `bos_token`/`eos_token` in tokenizer_config.json. Also lock `tokenizer_version` in manifest so catalog doesn't pick an incompatible release. After tokenizer change, re-run bench with seq_len=2048 and batch sweep up to 4.

Alex Cheng: I'll update the manifest (change tokenizer_config pointer, add tokenizer_version, and add a note about emoji tests). Kicking off another bench with seq_len=2048 and max_batch=4. CC @InfraBot to reserve infra and @Sam K for a quick CR on manifest. Will paste ANSIBLE job id when started.

InfraBot: infra-bot: Provision request queued (req-7892). Reserved p4d x1 for 2h. ETA ~3m.

Sam K: Ack — will review the manifest in ~30m. If tokenizer changes are non-breaking, we can push the catalog entry to staging after the next bench.

Alex Cheng: Thanks all — posting results once the longer sweep finishes. If anyone wants to try a headless run with different `do_lower_case` settings LMK and I can add a pass/fail prompt set. :thumbsup:
